items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez relies on high volume rather than one-punch knockout power.
Eros Medic has a 100% finish rate across all of his professional fights.
items.quote: Eros Medic who again is has a 100% finish rate or at least in all of his fights as well. 16 pro fights for Medic, none of which have gone to the scorecards.

items.claim: Eros Medic starts fights fast and swings wildly, making him vulnerable to being hit and caught by counters.
items.quote: the way that Ero swings and the way that Euro starts fights and blitzes fights, yes, he is there to be hit.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez is completely unproven in the championship rounds.
items.quote: D-Rod's completely unproven in those championship rounds as well
